original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Exact census of same-invocation 3-cycle owner permutations among three distinct occupied groups in the selected PR1094 T16 map; only the complex idle-rank moment may change.
scope_change_reason: Refines the selected-packing card to the direct same-call subdomain of the broader three-role cyclic-transfer question left open by PR1790. Every move permutes three existing roles among the same three already eligible families in one invocation, making the capacity and family checks exact and finite. Cross-call cycles and longer sequences are excluded. The positive three-owner cycle in PR #1154 is on the different PR1117 route with a different local word and slack pattern; it does not cover the selected PR1094 map census here.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex supplier binds. A cheaper idle remainder profile could raise its moment endpoint; the bit supplier remains fixed. This exact census finds no strictly cheaper same-call 3-cycle, so the domain realizes 0 percent of the fixed-word packing headroom.
stop_rule: Exhaust all ordered supported (remainder,width) type triples in each of the selected map's 144 calls, check exact nonnegative post-cycle slacks, and compare every distinct resulting rank-histogram transition with the selected complex moment at its certified endpoint using both pinned rational moment engines. Stop this domain if every transition is an exact tie or strictly more expensive; do not generalize to cross-call or longer cycles.
evidence: Selected PR1094 T16 source map: 49,408 supported ordered type patterns, 4,417 capacity-feasible patterns, 255 distinct transfer states, and 35 distinct old/new idle-rank histogram transitions. The two exact engines certify 19 histogram ties and 16 strictly more expensive transitions; none lowers the selected complex moment. A concrete cost-improving algebra fixture and a feasible worsening source witness test the price sign. Both selected suppliers are source-priced; bit is unchanged, complex binds, no new kappa.
author: Codex
ai_assistance: Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance: source-bounded search design, exact type census, rational interval pricing, verifier, tests, and packaging. Prior owner map/construction credits are retained in README.

open_questions.question: Can cross-call three-role cycles lower idle cost when each destination family is either free at that call or vacated by a simultaneous selected move?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This extends the no-improvement result beyond same-call permutations and is the remaining direct three-role owner-transfer class identified by PR1790.
open_questions.first_step: Build an exact join over source role times, destination windows, current family occupancy, and the three affected group slacks; first screen the seven rank-7 groups before any broader search.
open_questions.blocked_by: A target group already occupied by a nonmoving role in that call is illegal; the same-call type census does not certify cross-call compatibility.
